transfer.interpretation: Environment hashes check internal consistency, not hardware attestation. A repeated same-UUID process is not an independent physical GPU.

selected_vs_roofline_3p.difference_definition: candidate median APE minus baseline median APE, percentage points; negative favors candidate
selected_vs_roofline_3p.limitations: Descriptive resampling of this registered set; few families, unmodeled dependence and session drift limit inference. Raw event repeats are never resampled as independent sessions. Not a prediction interval or guaranteed population coverage.

challenge.interpretation: Point accuracy, tail errors, ordering, OOD flags and timing variability must be considered together. No retuning is performed here.

interpretation: All models share training labels and heldout targets. Selection used development only. Separate acquisition comparisons use explicitly revealed candidate labels.
